DOP: paṇṇa n. [ S. parṇa], 1. a leaf; Abh 543 (~aṃ pattaṃ); Vin I 201, 21 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~āni bhesajjāni nimbapaṇṇaṃ …); III 212, 24 (tiṇena vā ~ena vā paṭicchādetvā āgantabbaṃ na tv eva naggena āgantabbaṃ); A I 182, 12 (tiṇāni vā ~āni vā … ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā); Ud 77, 8* (yassa mūlaṃ chamā natthi ~ā natthi kuto latā); Sn 811 (~e vāri yathā na lippati; Nidd I 135, 3 : ~aṃ vuccati padumapattaṃ); Ja I 167, 25 (eḷako … ~āni khādituṃ āraddho); V 441, 30´ (~āni āharāpetvā dve puṭe katvā); Ap 239, 5 (tassa ~aṃ mayā dinnaṃ); Vism 245, 20 (~aṃ sarena vijjhitvā); Sv 95, 23 (so rukkhaṃ pi disvā ettakāni ettha ~ānī ti jānāti); 1012, 18 (~āni pakkhipitvā tāpita-udakenāpi dhovituṃ vaṭṭati); Ps II 383, 3 (paribhuttāvasesakaṃ … ~ena veṭhetvā tiṇagahane ṭhapesi); As 378, 31 (ekaccānaṃ hi rukkhānaṃ ~āni suriyātapena pasāriyanti rattiṃ patikuṭanti); — ifc see kappāsika- ( sv kappāsikā ), kāra- ( sv kāra 2 ), ketakī-, chatta- ( sv chatta 1 ), tāla- ( sv tāla 1 ), du- ( sv du 2 ), nimba- ( sv nimba 2 ), paduminī-, sūpeyya-; — 2. a leaf for writing upon, a written leaf, a note, a letter; Ja I 178, 28 (satta rājāno … amhākaṃ rajjaṃ vā detu yuddhaṃ vā ti Bārāṇasirañño ~aṃ pesayiṃsu); 452, 11 (seṭṭhi ~aṃ vācetvā); II 174, 1 (ekaṃ pana gāthaṃ bandhitvā ~aṃ likhitvā); Sp 452, 29 (~e vā potthake vā akkharāni likhati); Sv 215, 11 (savaḍḍhikaṃ iṇaṃ niyyādetvā ~aṃ phālāpeyya); Ps II 123, 13 (dve pi ~āni antarāmagge samāgacchiṃsu); 371, 6 (rājayuttehi likhitaṃ ~aṃ yāva rājamuddikāya na lañchitaṃ hoti na tāva rājapaṇṇan ti saṅkhaṃ gacchati); Dhp-a II 129, 19 (mayhaṃ pi ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ ~e āropehi); — ifc see iṇa-; — 3. a feather, a wing; — ifc see supaṇṇa; — °’- ākāra , m. [paṇṇa + ākāra 2 ], a present, a gift; Abh 356 (~o paheṇakaṃ); Ja IV 316, 15 (tassā atthāya bahuṃ ~aṃ datvā amacce pesesi); V 458, 14 (~ena saddhiṃ paṇṇāni pahiṇiṃsu); VI 368, 8 foll. (rājā bodhisattassa sahassamūlaṃ ~aṃ pesesi dovārike ādiṃ katvā sakalanagaravāsino ~e pahiṇiṃsu); 404, 17 (tumhākaṃ anucchavikaṃ ~aṃ olokento ajja imaṃ maṇiratanaṃ labhimha handa naṃ gaṇhatha); Dhp-a I 407, 15 (bahūpakārā me suṇisā ~aṃ assā karissāmi); IV 189, 7 (aññena me ~ena attho natthi rattasākharukkhe va āhareyyāsī ti); Ap 185, 3 (~aṃ labhitvāna); Sp 75, 9 (Asoko … pahiṇi … aññaṃ ca abhisekatthāya bahuvidhaṃ ~aṃ seyyathīdaṃ saṅkhaṃ …); Pj II 78, 16 (piyavacanāni ~āni ca pesesi); Mhv 15:71 (manussā ānesuṃ ~e samantato); — °- dhārasadisaṃ in cpd in Ee at Ja V 205, 26´ is wr for pattādhārasadisaṃ ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — °- puṭa , m. , a funnel or cup or basket made of leaves; Vin III 208, 11 (~aṃ bandhitvā); Ja III 366, 16 (~e bahutaraṃ loṇaṃ adaṃsu); 407, 8 (~ena udakaṃ āharitvā); Pv-a 168, 21 ; — °- bhisi , f. , a cushion or bolster stuffed with leaves; Vin IV 40, 10 ; Sp 1218, 22 ; — °- musalā in Ee, Se at D III 94, 4 is wr for panna- qv sv pajjati 1 ; — °- saññā , f. , a leaf token; a sign made of leaves; Ja I 153, 7 (khettaṃ pana āvijjhitvā ~aṃ bandhantū ti); IV 262, 27 ; Cp-a 152, 8 ; — °- saṭa , °-kasaṭa ( or paṇṇaka-saṭa), paṇṇaka-saṭa), m. , dead leaves; M I 21, 1 (vāto vā ~aṃ ereti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se paṇṇakasaṭaṃ; Ps I 120, 19 : ~aṃ eretī ti vāto vā paṇṇakacavaraṃ ghaṭṭeti, Ce so; Ee °-sataṃ; Be, Se paṇṇakasaṭaṃ); Vism 74, 11 (pādena ~aṃ apanetvā vasitabbaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee paṇṇakasaṭaṃ); Sp 612, 13 (~an ti purāṇapaṇṇaṃ); — see also tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇasaṭa ( sv tiṇa ); — °- santhata , m. , a layer of leaves as a bed or mat; Ja III 411, 9* (nisīdetvā ~e; 411, 25´ foll.: vālikāsanānaṃ upari santhate °-santhare nisīdāpetvā, santharo hi idha santhato ti vutto, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce °-santhāre … santhāro …); IV 286, 22* (te ~ā ramaṇīyā; 287, 20´ : tālīsapattādigandhapaṇṇasantharā); — °- santhara , °-santhāra, m. , a layer of leaves as a bed or mat; Vin IV 274, 33 (seyyaṃ nāma antamaso °-santhāro pi); A I 136, 32 (kharā gokaṇṭakahatā bhūmi tanuko ~o, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee °-santhāro); Ja VI 24, 1 foll. (sace pallaṅke na nisīdati ~aṃ paññāpethā ti … idh’ eva te nisīdassu niyate ~e, Se so; Be °-santhāraṃ … ~e; Ce ~aṃ … °-santhate; Ee °-santhāraṃ … °-santhate); Nidd I 493, 9 (~e, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se °-santhāre); Ap 137, 14 (Siddhatthassa bhagavato adāsiṃ ~aṃ); Mil 366, 2 (tiṇasanthāre pi °-santhāre pi); — °- sālaka , n. , a leaf-hut; a hut roofed with leaves; Bv 2:31 (aṭṭhadosasamākiṇṇaṃ pajahiṃ ~aṃ); Cp 1:1:6; — °- sālā , f. ( and ~a, n. ), a leaf-hut; a hut roofed with leaves; Ja I 8, 15 (~āya bhittiyaṃ … akkharāni chinditvā); III 246, 3 (himavantaṃ pavisitvā ~aṃ māpetvā isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā); IV 318, 18 (udumbarabhittipādaṃ naḷabhittikaṃ ~aṃ katvā dvāraṃ yojetvā); VI 276, 18* (passa tvaṃ ~āyo vibhattā bhāgaso mitā; 276, 20´ : ~āyo ti nānāpaṇiyapuṇṇe āpaṇe, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se nānābhaṇḍapuṇṇe); 557, 13* (so nūna khattiyo eko ~āya acchati); Ap 239, 2 (~e nisinno ’mhi paṇṇabhojanabhojano); Bv 2:28 (assamo sukato mayhaṃ ~ā sumāpitā; Bv-a 75, 29 : ~ā ti paṇṇachadanasālā); Mil 281, 22 (Vessantaro rājā puttadānaṃ datvā ~aṃ pavisitvā nipajji); — ifc see piṭṭhi- ( sv piṭṭhi 1 ); — ~-jhāpaka, mfn. , who sets fire to a leaf-hut; Ja III 71, 4 ; — °- susa , °- sosa , mfn. [ cf S. parṇaśuṣ], drying the leaves; Pj I 15, 12 (yathā °-sosā vātā °-susā ti vuccanti evaṃ bodhetā pajāyā ti buddho) = Nidd-a I 441, 23 foll.; — see also omukhanikkhittapaṇṇakosasaṇṭhāna ( sv omukha ), khīrapaṇṇi(n), takapaṇṇi ( sv taka 2 ).
